scope: Chipped 3.0.7, Minecraft 1.20.1; analysis/design only. No SIU integration implemented.
authority: Published 3.0.7 binaries and native gameplay are authoritative. The public 1.20.1 branch has later changes (including craft validation) and is supporting evidence only.

flow: Select existing player-inventory stack (selection-only slots; no pickup)
Craft replaces that inventory stack in place, preserving count
Shift+Craft replaces matching player-inventory stacks; never other open containers

grid.nativeScroll: Wheel only, 8px step; search resets scroll

native.search: Localized display-name contains, case insensitive; 50 characters; requires material selection
native.preview: Native FakeLevel/connected textures; full door halves and iron-bar connections. Fixed isometric, not free rotation or processing animation.
native.observedNativeIssue: Native bottom-row lower portion paints but does not select. Terra reproduced upper-half vs lower-half discrepancy. Proposed window must match render/hit bounds, not copy this defect.

alternatives.name: Upper native panel plus embedded source inventory
Separate preview and variant windows
alternatives.cost: Extra window/focus management and potentially ambiguous selection

alternatives.name: Integrated workshop plus material picker
alternatives.benefit: Compact, self-contained, no duplicate inventory or item transfer
alternatives.cost: Needs purpose-built selection UI and authenticated action bridge

recommended.chrome: SIU window geometry/controls with warm brown and beige matching native Chipped artwork
recommended.layout: Compact material-reference bar across top; full native preview/four mode buttons/Craft left, search and nine-by-six variant viewport right
recommended.source: Icon, count/name, Choose button referencing one existing player inventory stack. No input/output slots or cursor transfer.
recommended.picker: Bounded popup of eligible real inventory stacks, compact to item count, normal dismissal. No global interception of regular SIU inventory clicks.
recommended.scrollbar: Slim proposed scrollbar/position indicator; clearly label it as an addition since native is wheel-only.
recommended.dimensions: Approximately 268x178 GUI units, finalize from actual preview bounds. Reserve complete preview silhouettes; never crop outlines or shrink all cells.
recommended.stationRule: Seven workbenches share one UI/texture. Vary title, recipe filter and displayed blocks; do not invent station-switching tabs.
recommended.stability: Keep nine-by-six viewport stable during filtering; reserved empty cells are deliberate rather than excess border padding.

mustBridge: Native craft packet assumes player.containerMenu is WorkbenchMenu; use authenticated desktop session payload
Refresh menu selection, results, search editability and scroll together
Translate menu slot IDs to inventory indices correctly (main inventory first, hotbar last)
Record source position and recipe type; validate two-block source lifetime/range (upstream stillValid always true)
Revalidate selected stack and permitted variant on server; handle moved/replaced stacks
Maintain independent state across simultaneous workbench windows
apiForecast.assessment: Existing supported API looks sufficient for a compatibility-side custom definition reusing Chipped widgets. A blind native crop is insufficient. No new Core API has been proven necessary; integration is not implemented or tested. Direct selection from normal SIU inventory would need a generic opt-in observation hook if desired, deliberately not required by recommended popup.

pdfGuidance: Visual-first, around 10–15 pages if useful: native anatomy/workflow, three options, best design, key states, seven-station gallery, implementation forecast, evidence/limits/sources. Clearly label all mockups as proposals. No production/gameplay-compatibility claims.
